about_the_game:
CrossPlanet – The Ultimate Multiplayer Shooter Experience

CrossPlanet is a thrilling third-person shooter that delivers fast-paced, skill-based combat across dynamic battlefields. Whether you're facing off against other players in intense PVP firefights or teaming up to battle monstrous alien creatures in PVE missions, CrossPlanet offers action-packed gameplay with a focus on strategy, movement, and precision gunplay.

A Shooter Focused on Gameplay First

No unnecessary fluff—CrossPlanet is built for fluid movement, satisfying gunplay, and competitive action. Players can sprint, take cover, aim down sights, and unleash devastating firepower across a variety of maps and modes. With a robust selection of 11 weapons, each with distinct handling and playstyles, every encounter feels fresh and tactical.

Battle Across Diverse Worlds

From futuristic military bases to hostile alien landscapes, CrossPlanet’s maps are designed for strategic combat and environmental storytelling. Engage in team-based skirmishes, solo challenges, and cooperative missions as you adapt to ever-changing battle scenarios.

Key Features:

✅ Multiplayer Warfare – Face off in competitive PVP battles or squad up for cooperative PVE missions.
✅ Diverse Arsenal – Wield 15 unique weapons, each designed for specific playstyles.
✅ Tactical Movement – Sprint, evade, double jump, jetpack and use map layouts to outmaneuver your enemies.
✅ PVE Battles – Fight against swarms of alien creatures and massive bosses in thrilling co-op missions, or risk going in solo.
✅ Skill-Based Combat – No pay-to-win mechanics—victory comes from strategy and reflexes.

CrossPlanet features 10 PVP Multiplayer maps, 15 Modes, 10 Unique Armors to wear and show off, earned through playing the game! Plus, a range of PVE missions against waves of enemies and huge bosses, either alone or with friends! 

CrossPlanet is designed for players who love pure shooter gameplay without distractions. Whether you're a competitive player looking for your next challenge or a PVE fan ready to take on alien horrors, prepare to drop into the action.

Are you ready to dominate the battlefield?

Join our Discord, and follow us on socials to stay up to date, and get playtest access!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10, Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel i5-9600K or AMD Ryzen 5 2600X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 970 or AMD Radeon RX 570
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10, Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel i5-14400 or AMD Ryzen 5 9600X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD RX 6600 XT or Nvidia RTX 3060
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
